summary: Retrieve playlists with optional filters and track details
description: Returns a playlist entity containing the list of belonging tracks. Includes the new 'audiodownload_allowed' boolean to indicate if a track can be downloaded. If 'audiodownload_allowed' is false, the 'audiodownload' field will be returned as an empty string (as of April 2022). Use the 'track_type' parameter to include singles or album tracks. At least one of id, name, user_id, access_token, or user_name must be provided together with the required client_id.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wrap the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with json format and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The max number of results to return. Default is 10, max 200. Using 'all' still caps at 200.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the queried field(s). Append '_asc' or '_desc' for direction. Ascending is default.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, adds 'results_fullcount' in the header indicating total rows without limit/offset. Use sparingly due to performance impact.

parameters.name: namesearch
parameters.description: Search a playlist by name (playlist_name matching *searchquery*).

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: One or more author IDs (no access token required).

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: A valid OAuth2 access token for the Jamendo user.

parameters.name: datebetween
parameters.description: Filter playlists created between two dates. Format 'from_to' (both integers).

parameters.name: audioformat
parameters.description: Audio format for the 'audio' field. Default is mp31 if omitted.

parameters.name: track_type
parameters.description: Select tracks of a certain type. Default returns only albumtracks.

parameters.name: imagesize
parameters.description: Desired cover image size in pixels.

parameters.name: positionbetween
parameters.description: Filter on the track position in the playlist. Format 'from_to' (both integers).

parameters.name: audiodlformat
parameters.description: Audio download format for the 'audiodownload' field. Defaults to audioformat or mp32.

notes: The 'audiodownload_allowed' field (boolean) indicates if a track can be downloaded via your app.
If 'audiodownload_allowed' is false, the 'audiodownload' field will be returned as an empty string (effective April 2022).
At least one of id, name, user_id, access_token, or user_name must be supplied together with client_id.
Array parameters (e.g., id, user_id, track_type) can be provided as comma‑separated values.
